name: Biomedical Engineering High School Internship Program
org: University of Minnesota Department of Biomedical Engineering
what_you_do: Rising seniors spend six weeks touring labs like the Visible Heart Lab. They do hands-on research with a grad student. They share their work at a poster session.
who_can_apply: Students entering their senior year. No other rules are listed.
pay_detail: A stipend and bus transportation are provided; the amount is not stated.
deadline_text: The page says it is not accepting applications for Summer 2026. Check back for Summer 2027.
how_to_apply: Not described. Phone the department at 612-624-4507.
notes: At the end, interns get a letter of support. It comes from the engineering faculty.
